principles: Read-only, advisory: writes nothing, no findings, no gate.
Pure leaf for the metric math (inject ordered story data); hermetically testable.
Honest by construction: report N + a conservative significance gate; never a premature causal claim.
Reuse existing reads (store findings/order + readActivityLogTail); no new storage.
Two clearly-separated layers: observational fast signal vs accruing RCT.
drivers: Turn the live loop into evidence without overstating it.
Fast signal computable now (and re-runnable after the 3.5 backfill = the re-run-learning-curve step).
Register correctly as a read-only command incl. process-fact-levels (or the contract suite fails).

options.name: Read-only command: pure metric leaf + store/activity adapter (chosen)
pros: fast layer needs no forward data; usable immediately + re-runnable after backfill
cons: RCT layer is mostly 'insufficient N' until forward data accrues (acceptable: honest by design)

options.name: Persist a metrics cache
cons: Introduces a write path (out of scope); the computation is cheap; recompute-on-read is simpler + safer

options.name: Fold into learning_validate
cons: Conflates validity (drift) with effectiveness (predictive value/RCT); muddies both reports

chosen: Read-only command: pure metric leaf + store/activity adapter (chosen)
rationale: A dedicated read-only command with a pure metric leaf mirrors the proven learning_validate pattern, keeps the math hermetically testable, and cleanly separates the observational fast signal from the accruing RCT — while staying honest (N + significance gate). A metrics cache would add an out-of-scope write path, and folding into learning_validate would conflate drift with effectiveness.

preMortem.trigger: The arm comparison reports a causal win on tiny N.
preMortem.consequence: Dishonest evidence — the exact trap Baseline A warned against.
preMortem.mitigation: Conservative significance gate (min N per arm); below it significant=false note='insufficient N'; the smoke asserts significant=false on a small-N fixture and true only when a fixture crosses the threshold; the human report leads with 'observational' / 'accrues over future stories'.

preMortem.scenario: The new command breaks the process-fact contract.
preMortem.trigger: learning_effectiveness added to cli-engine but not PROCESS_FACT_LEVELS.
preMortem.consequence: Full npm test process-fact-contract fails late at DONE.
preMortem.mitigation: Add the L0 experience-layer-read entry to PROCESS_FACT_LEVELS in the same change; verifier runs full npm test; run npm test before REVIEW.

preMortem.trigger: The handler accidentally persists or omits READ_ONLY_COMMANDS membership.
preMortem.mitigation: Mirror learning_validate exactly: no writes, in READ_ONLY_COMMANDS, command-policy ownershipClass readOnly; verifier asserts no write/finding/gate calls + READ_ONLY_COMMANDS membership.

preMortem.scenario: The leaf is impure or non-deterministic.
preMortem.trigger: deriveSignatureCandidate-style I/O or time/random in the metric leaf.
preMortem.mitigation: Leaf imports only node:/types; story order/findings/arms are injected; the smoke asserts determinism + never-NaN.
